The work product incorporates interactive elements, multimedia resources, and real-world examples to enhance understanding and retention of information.

Methods of delivery could include:

  • Virtual ILT
  • Blended Learning
  • Self-directed learning or digital learning
  • Online portal to search for help content
  • Virtual support via chatbots
  • Online help built into the solution
  • Playbooks/flipbooks
  • Quick reference guides
  • Top Tips

The content is designed to create an immersive and user-centric learning experience, aligning with the their unique needs, preferences, and learning styles. Additionally, the content takes into consideration the end-user's prior knowledge and experience to provide personalized and relevant learning opportunities.

This work product is used to create engaging and interactive educational materials that go beyond static information delivery. Learning content aims to create a more profound impact on learners. Utilizing innovative approaches, the goal is to provide a comprehensive learning experience that empowers learners to apply knowledge effectively and adapt to on-going change.

While traditional training may simply transfer knowledge, learning content aims to create a deeper impact by not only imparting knowledge but also facilitating the development of the desired mindset, behaviors, and ways of working that drive lasting change. These materials are designed to provide individuals with comprehensive knowledge and skills while also fostering a positive and engaging learning experience.
